npm-4.fix: Keep the upstream two-argument calling convention, return Effect.Effect<BasicCredential, InvalidBasicAuthUsernameError>, and use Effect.fail for colon-bearing usernames. Adapt PackagePublish.test.ts success and rejection calls to execute the Effect, preserving the existing assertions. This API deviation is law:EF-1; central bookkeeping only.
